Simplified pi-session-graph UX: added /session-graphs and pigraph graphs to generate four timestamped Desktop HTML/SVG graph views; removed public /session-graph registration/docs; documented graph types; validated npm run lint and npx tsx bin/pigraph.ts graphs. Closed graph UX tickets psg-5xbf, psg-8hoa, psg-7e5z, psg-lvh0, psg-ga8x.
Done and pushed. Commit: ```text 8d2792fc Simplify session graph outputs ``` Implemented: - Added `/session-graphs` - Ad

Finished remaining pinned lineage/session-store tickets across suite: pi-session-store now has pi.extensions metadata and docs for pinned lineage-name delegation; pi-session-move labels names as pinned lineage names while preserving session display sync; agent-session-store imports relocation-lineages sidecars into pinned_lineage_name labels; pi-session-graph status displays current display name and pinned lineage name. Validation: pi-session-store npm run lint; pi-session-move npx tsc --noEmit; agent-session-store npm run lint/build-store/export-graph; pi-session-graph npm run lint and status smoke with pinned label.

Added agent-session-store SVG temporal lineage generator without changing npm run temporal-lineage. New npm/CLI command temporal-lineage-svg writes temporal-lineage-svg.html and temporal-lineage-focused-svg.html using inline SVG rather than Mermaid, preserving old timeline outputs. Validated npm run lint and npx tsx bin/agent-session-store.ts temporal-lineage-svg.

Added rough archived-style whole-lineage graph generator to pi-session-graph: npm run whole-lineage writes whole-lineage-graph.mmd/html with simple white Mermaid page under ~/.pi/agent/session-graph. Documented in README. Validated npm run lint and npm run whole-lineage. Closed psg-mg9n.

Renamed agent-session-store graph builder from scripts/build-temporal-lineage.ts / npm run temporal-lineage to scripts/build-graphs.ts / npm run build-graphs. Updated agent-session-store CLI command and README; preserved output behavior. Validation: npm run lint, npm run build-graphs, npx tsx bin/agent-session-store.ts build-graphs.

Cleaned up failed/experimental SVG lineage generator in agent-session-store. Removed scripts/build-temporal-lineage-svg.ts plus temporal-lineage-svg npm and CLI entries, leaving build-graphs as the graph builder and Graphviz ticket as the intended large-graph SVG direction. Validation: npm run lint.

Reverted only /session-graphs generated output style in pi-session-graph while keeping simplified command surface. /session-graphs now uses the prior session_graph_viewer/temporal_graph/Mermaid artifact writers under ~/Desktop/session-graph instead of the simplified four-file custom HTML/SVG prototype. Also removed lingering session-graphs status-bar setStatus calls. Validation: npm run lint; npx tsx bin/pigraph.ts graphs.

Aligned pi-session-graph /session-graphs output names/titles with the old/agent-session-store graph generator. /session-graphs and pigraph graphs now run agent-session-store build-graphs and report lineage-full, lineage-focused, timeline-projects, timeline-sessions under ~/.pi/agent/session-graph instead of Desktop viewer artifact names. Validation: npm run lint; npx tsx bin/pigraph.ts graphs.

Implemented lineage split naming warnings in pi-session-move. Added detection for current-lineage forks and branch-specific currentSession pinned names; /move-status and /move-lineage now warn when a forked lineage branch is sharing an ancestor/root pinned name and suggest /move-lineage --name <new-branch-name>. Validation: npx tsc --noEmit.

Implemented remaining practical lineage-name split behaviors. pi-session-move now auto-pins a lineage name from a usable current Pi session display name when no pinned lineage name exists, preserves explicit user overrides, distinguishes explicit diverge edges in split warnings, and suggests branch-specific names based on cwd. pi-session-graph /session-status now displays current lineage split/fork count and branch naming suggestion. Validation: pi-session-move npx tsc --noEmit; pi-session-graph npm run lint and pigraph status.

Restored access to the intermediate pi-session-graph interactive viewers while keeping modern graph names. /session-graphs now runs agent-session-store build-graphs for lineage-full/focused and timeline-projects/sessions, and additionally writes timestamped interactive viewer files to ~/Desktop/session-graphs: <timestamp>-lineage-full-interactive.html from writeHtmlViewer and <timestamp>-timeline-projects-interactive.html from writeTemporalHtml. Updated README. Validation: npm run lint; npx tsx bin/pigraph.ts graphs.

Completed four-file interactive graph output in pi-session-graph. /session-graphs now writes timestamped lineage-full-interactive, lineage-focused-interactive, timeline-projects-interactive, and timeline-sessions-interactive files under ~/Desktop/session-graphs. Focused interactive lineage filters to relocation/move/overlay edges; timeline-sessions opens with session grouping selected. Updated README. Validation: npm run lint; npx tsx bin/pigraph.ts graphs.

Aligned graph output decisions across agent-session-store and pi-session-graph. agent-session-store build-graphs now writes timestamped outputs to ~/Desktop/session-graphs by default, with timestamped HTML page titles for lineage-full, lineage-focused, timeline-projects, and timeline-sessions. pi-session-graph /session-graphs now reports the timestamped Desktop build-graphs files and still writes four timestamped interactive comparison files. Updated docs. Validation: agent-session-store npm run lint and npm run build-graphs; pi-session-graph npm run lint and npx tsx bin/pigraph.ts graphs; checked generated HTML titles.

Changed graph output defaults per user decision. pi-session-graph /session-graphs and pigraph graphs now only write four timestamped interactive HTML viewers after rebuild/export, not non-interactive reports. agent-session-store build-graphs now writes only four timestamped HTML reports by default; JSON/MMD/MD data/debug artifacts require --include-data. Updated READMEs. Validation: agent-session-store npm run lint; npm run build-graphs (confirmed no data files); npm run build-graphs -- --include-data (confirmed data files); pi-session-graph npm run lint; npx tsx bin/pigraph.ts graphs (confirmed only interactive file lines).

Implemented revised command philosophy. pi-session-graph now registers only /session-status, /session-lineage, and /session-graphs; removed /session-leaves and /session-repos slash commands while documenting pigraph leaves/repos as CLI/admin. pi-session-move now registers /move, /move-prune, and new /lineage-name <name>; removed /move-status and /move-lineage slash commands and removed undocumented short flag aliases. pi-session-store is deprecated as a Pi slash wrapper in README and no longer declares Pi extension metadata. Validation: pi-session-graph npm run lint and registerCommand verification; pi-session-move npx tsc --noEmit and registerCommand verification; pi-session-store npm run lint and package.json pi metadata check.

Removed deprecated pi-session-store references from other extension docs and cleaned stale move wording. pi-session-graph README no longer lists pi-session-store in suite/boundaries. pi-session-move README no longer references pi-session-store and documents assistant-only session_move diagnostic tool; stale status/lineage and user-facing relocate wording was updated. pi-repo-move README now says move evidence/session-only moves. Validation: pi-session-graph npm run lint; pi-session-move npx tsc --noEmit; pi-repo-move npm run lint.

Implemented full pi-session-graph report-pack roadmap: /session-graphs and pigraph graphs now generate ~/Desktop/session-graphs/<timestamp>/ with index/README, archive full DOT/SVG/raw data, repo jump map, hotspots, false starts, meaningful lineage forest, project focus timelines, session neighborhood, and ECharts timeline MVP. Closed psg-5nv3, psg-ymfr, psg-0jyk, psg-a88d, psg-7d9h, psg-tsh7, psg-srk2. Bumped package to 0.1.5 and updated README. Validation: npm run build; npm run lint; node dist/bin/pigraph.js graphs; npm pack --dry-run; verified no open tickets.

Fixed pi-session-graph npm/Pi install backend resolution: agent-session-store binary lookup now checks sibling node_modules/.bin and sibling agent-session-store dist path, covering Pi's ~/.pi/agent/npm/node_modules layout where dependencies are hoisted beside pi-session-graph. Bumped to 0.1.6. Validation: npm run build; npm run lint; node dist/bin/pigraph.js graphs; npm pack --dry-run.

Hardened pi-session-graph interactive HTML rendering after lineage-focused page appeared blank in Safari. Render now uses DOM text nodes for lane headers instead of innerHTML, tolerates unlabeled nodes and missing edge confidence/labels, avoids optional chaining in selected checks, and displays a visible render error block instead of blanking the graph if client-side rendering fails. Bumped to 0.1.7. Validation: npm run build; npm run lint; node dist/bin/pigraph.js graphs; verified focused HTML has 203 nodes/194 edges and new renderer; npm pack --dry-run.

Improved pi-session-graph interactive report usability/debuggability without version bump: HTML viewer now includes static fallback content rendered server-side, visible node/edge counts before JS runs, and explicit helper text that search is optional and should be left blank to show all nodes. This prevents blank pages if Safari/client JS fails and clarifies search behavior. Validation: npm run build; npm run lint; node dist/bin/pigraph.js graphs; verified generated focused report contains fallback/helper text.

Fixed pi-session-graph interactive HTML script syntax error causing fallback-only rendering. The embedded script had a template-literal escaping bug: join('\n') became a literal newline inside a single-quoted JS string in generated HTML. Changed to join('\\n'), removed optional chaining in button handlers, and made Mermaid export tolerate missing labels/types. Validation: npm run build; npm run lint; node dist/bin/pigraph.js graphs; extracted generated script from focused report and verified `node --check` succeeds.

Adjusted meaningful lineage forest to try the cleaner session-node-only model: filtered out self-loop records such as compaction edges from reports/04-meaningful-lineage-forest so the default insight graph uses real session boxes as vertices and direct inter-session edges only. Validation: npm run build; npm run lint; node dist/bin/pigraph.js graphs; verified generated meaningful forest has 165 edges and 0 self-loops; opened SVG.

Clarified Graphviz session labels around agent/lineage vs repo/container: DOT clusters now use repo/container labels derived from cwd/session bucket, and session boxes display both `agent: <lineage>` and `repo: <container>` instead of sometimes using one or the other as the primary label. Fixed bucket decoding to preserve repo hyphens. Validation: npm run build; npm run lint; node dist/bin/pigraph.js graphs; inspected DOT labels for Ariadne moving across repo containers.

Improved Graphviz DOT/SVG readability for pi-session-graph: labels now render real line breaks instead of literal /n text, edge labels no longer say low-value 'manifest' and instead show move/date/confidence, repo container cluster labels are explicitly prefixed with 'repo:' and styled dashed/grey. Validation: npm run build; npm run lint; node dist/bin/pigraph.js graphs; inspected DOT samples and opened meaningful-lineage SVG.

Cleaned Graphviz labels in pi-session-graph: removed low-information provider 'pi' from session boxes (non-pi providers still show), renamed 'start' to 'session start', omitted 'authoritative' from confirmed edge labels, and updated legend wording to 'confirmed move/event' vs inferred/low confidence. Validation: npm run build; npm run lint; generated sample graph and verified labels.

Updated pi-session-graph movement graph labels per user direction: removed line counts from DOT session boxes, show arrived/departed for non-leaf visits, active since for leaves, lineage start with filename source for roots, and edge labels as '<Agent> Moved', '<Agent> Inferred Move', or '<Agent> Branched' with branch edges red. Added simple agent-label propagation across connected sessions so edges do not fall back to generic 'agent'. Validation: npm run build; npm run lint; node dist/bin/pigraph.js graphs; inspected DOT samples for Ariadne labels and active-since boxes.

Added standalone work islands graph and current-session propagation in pi-session-graph. Report pack now includes reports/04-standalone-work-islands.dot/svg ranking no-movement sessions by first-to-last event span and compactions, explicitly surfacing cypv1 and checkyourphotosv1; meaningful lineage forest moved to reports/05. Report pack generation now accepts current session so DOT can highlight current when available. Validation: npm run build; npm run lint; node dist/bin/pigraph.js graphs; confirmed cypv1/checkyourphotosv1 appear in standalone DOT/SVG.

Removed current/leaf highlighting from generated session graph outputs. DOT and Mermaid no longer add star markers or purple current-session fill; legends no longer mention current session. Validation: npm run build; npm run lint; node dist/bin/pigraph.js graphs; verified meaningful/archive DOT output contains no star, current-session legend, or current purple fill.

Fixed branch labeling in Graphviz movement reports: fan-out from one source session to multiple distinct destination sessions now labels those edges as '<Agent> Branched' and colors them red, even when raw manifests did not explicitly set mode=branch. Validation: npm run build; npm run lint; node dist/bin/pigraph.js graphs; confirmed Ariadne fan-out edges in 05-meaningful-lineage-forest.dot are red 'Ariadne Branched'.

Changed DOT movement report styling: repo/container cluster boxes are now orange instead of blue-on-blue; each agent/lineage name is assigned a stable palette color, the agent line in session labels is rendered in that color via Graphviz HTML labels, and movement edge stroke/text uses the same lineage color. Branches remain labeled Branched but now share the lineage color rather than overriding to red. Validation: npm run build; npm run lint; node dist/bin/pigraph.js graphs; inspected 05-meaningful-lineage-forest.dot for orange clusters and matching Ariadne node/edge colors.

Corrected graph colors per user clarification: reverted repo/container cluster boxes to the prior slate color and made the session/visit vertex boxes brown-orange. Kept lineage-specific agent text and edge colors. Validation: npm run build; npm run lint; node dist/bin/pigraph.js graphs; inspected DOT for cluster color #334155 and session fill #3f2f12.

Normalized repo labels and added per-agent chronological layout constraints in DOT movement graph. Repo labels now consistently use normalized absolute repo paths, collapsing duplicate pi-session-graph clusters caused by basename-vs-full-path and common /users/sam path variants. Added invisible per-agent chronological edges so Graphviz has constraints pushing later sessions/leaves to the right rather than relying only on movement topology/crossing minimization. Validation: npm run build; npm run lint; node dist/bin/pigraph.js graphs; confirmed only one pi-session-graph repo cluster remains and invisible chronological constraints are present.

Changed agent lineage colors from hash-into-fixed-palette to per-graph color-wheel distribution. Unique agent/lineage names are sorted and assigned evenly spaced HSL hues, so if there are N agents they divide the hue wheel by N; agent text and movement edges use those colors. Validation: npm run build; npm run lint; node dist/bin/pigraph.js graphs; inspected DOT colors for Ariadne, pi-extension-publisher, and session-suite-worker as evenly spaced green/purple/red.
